findings.title: Restore General fields’ association with the Save Settings form
findings.body: The General controls now belong to a separate form with no submit button. Clicking Save Settings submits only the instance form, omitting every General value. In triggarr/web/routes.py:531–539, save_settings replaces missing values with defaults and persists them: for example, a configured hard_max_per_cycle=10 becomes 0 (unlimited), and checked skip_unreleased becomes false. General edits are discarded, and even saving an unrelated instance change overwrites existing General settings. The existing test_general_fields_submit_with_the_save_settings_form explicitly guards this regression.
findings.recommendation: Restore id="settings-form" on the instance form and form="settings-form" on every General control, keeping Security separate. Run the existing form-association regression test.

next_steps: Restore the shared form association before merging.
